status: superseded failed validation runs, not accepted product evidence

runs.problem: Synthesis transport used the inherited 12-second read timeout; no accepted answers.
runs.remediation: Separate 40-second read timeout within a 45-second bounded stage for new inquiry roles.

problems: An irrelevant-detail answer was withheld after unsupported example quantities and a date-range tokenization error.
The paraphrase pair reviewer was unavailable.
Both semantic reviewers accepted a false 343-days-exceeds-12-months comparison.
The material-context answer treated absence of backup funds as an explicit zero-loss threshold and overstated the scope of one replay.
remediation: Constrain headings in tool schema; give concise structured correction feedback.
Preserve loss signs while treating date-range hyphens as separators.
Reject uncomputed digit-form days/months comparisons; require Python-authored relationships.
Include actual replay and withdrawal dates and the separate no-withdrawal recovery limitation.
Strengthen semantic checks for unsupported thresholds, conditional scope and genuine counterevidence.
Remove duplicated transport traces from paired semantic review payloads.

problems: Name, paraphrase and irrelevant-detail variants produced inconsistent analysis scope and differently qualified conclusions.
A material-context answer still contained an unsupported zero-loss-capacity interpretation and a favorable liquidity claim without a benchmark.
remediation: Resolve current reasoning-role contracts at call time and record their hashes to make runtime prompt versions observable.
Clarify that pair review compares substantive stance and caveats, not identical tool lists or extra supporting calculations.
Allow exact stated numerical inputs only with their extracted user-context citation; do not convert them into computed facts.
runs.note: The final live run is recorded separately. No universal stability or infallible semantic review is claimed.

problems: Name and paraphrase comparisons still differed in caveats and analysis scope.
A conclusion quoted CPI-aligned real growth alongside a different full-price-history interval.
remediation: Use temperature 0 for customer reasoning and omit operational traces/generated follow-up suggestions from planner inputs.
Require exact CPI-aligned start/end dates when quoting purchasing-power percentages.
runs.note: Zero temperature reduces sampling variation; it does not prove semantic invariance.

problems: Reference-format retries exhausted the old shared turn budget before a review repair could run.
Paraphrase and irrelevant-detail answers differed in treatment of the unspecified horizon.
remediation: Separate investigation, format-repair and reviewed-answer allowances in a bounded six-turn loop.
Use direct quotations from evidence rather than duplicating every number in a model-facing registry.
Provide complete profile fields and explicit unknowns to planning, synthesis and review.

limitations: These fixes do not make semantic LLM review infallible. Literal numeric checks do not prove every qualitative inference. Additional unseen-case and human evaluation remain necessary.
